company.name: New Relic
company.shortDescription: New Relic is a digital intelligence company that delivers full-stack visibility and analytics to enterprises.
company.description:
New Relic is a digital intelligence company that delivers full-stack visibility and analytics with more than 14,000 paid business accounts. The New Relic digital intelligence platform provides actionable insights to drive digital business results. 

The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

productsAndServices.description: Monitoring for web and mobile user experiences that helps organizations identify performance problems, usability friction, errors, and simulated journey failures affecting customer satisfaction and conversions.

productsAndServices.description: Monitoring for AI applications, models, and agent interactions that tracks performance, reliability, behavior, and token usage to help organizations operate AI systems safely and control costs.
productsAndServices.name: AI Observability

productsAndServices.description: Monitoring for hybrid, cloud, container, Kubernetes, database, and network infrastructure that correlates system health with application performance and operational events.
productsAndServices.name: Infrastructure Monitoring

productsAndServices.description: A log observability service for searching, analyzing, correlating, and managing logs across technology environments, with options to query data in place and apply AI-assisted analysis.
productsAndServices.name: Log Management

aiResearchSummary.text: New Relic is researching systems for processing coherent data, as described in 'System for processing coherent data,' which details a monitoring system that presents metrics or event data by monitoring state information from agents on computing systems. Additionally, 'Automation solutions for event logging and debugging on kubernetes' focuses on methods for linking and navigating data from distributed application clusters using edge modules and BPF probes. These areas highlight research in system monitoring and distributed application debugging.
